hops --help 2>&1 | head -60
hops fg --help 2>&1

cut -d, -f5 data/transactions.csv | sort -u; echo "---min/max event_time---"; cut -d, -f3 data/transactions.csv | tail -n +2 | sort -n | head -1; cut -d, -f3 data/transactions.csv | tail -n +2 | sort -n | tail -1

hops sql --help 2>&1; echo "===TRINO==="; hops trino --help 2>&1

cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg create transactions_raw392bc9 --version 1 --primary-key row_id --event-time event_time --features "row_id:string,account_id:string,event_time:bigint,amount:double,currency:string" --description "raw transactions" 2>&1
cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg create fx_rates392bc9 --version 1 --primary-key currency --features "currency:string,fx_rate:double" --description "fx rates to USD" 2>&1
cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg insert transactions_raw392bc9 --version 1 --file data/transactions.csv 2>&1 | tail -15
cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg insert fx_rates392bc9 --version 1 --file data/fx_rates.csv 2>&1 | tail -15
cd "$(pwd)" && hops trino tables 2>&1 | tail -20
cd "$(pwd)" && hops trino catalogs 2>&1 | tail -10; echo "===SCHEMAS==="; hops trino schemas iceberg 2>&1 | tail -20
cd "$(pwd)" && hops --no-verify trino schemas iceberg 2>&1 | tail -20
cd "$(pwd)" && hops --no-verify trino tables iceberg.mlpabf76686_featurestore 2>&1 | grep -i 392bc9

cd "$(pwd)" && hops --no-verify sql "
SELECT t.row_id, t.account_id, t.event_time,
  t.amount * f.fx_rate AS amount_usd,
  CASE WHEN (t.event_time/86400000) % 7 IN (2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend,
  SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.event_time RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_7d
FROM iceberg.mlpabf76686_featurestore.transactions_raw392bc9_1 t
JOIN iceberg.mlpabf76686_featurestore.fx_rates392bc9_1 f ON t.currency = f.currency
ORDER BY t.event_time LIMIT 5
" 2>&1 | tail -5
cd "$(pwd)" && hops --no-verify trino catalogs 2>&1 | tail -3

cd "$(pwd)" && hops --no-verify sql --catalog hive "
SELECT t.row_id, t.account_id, t.event_time,
  t.amount * f.fx_rate AS amount_usd,
  CASE WHEN (t.event_time/86400000) % 7 IN (2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend,
  SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.event_time RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_7d
FROM hive.mlpabf76686_featurestore.transactions_raw392bc9_1 t
JOIN hive.mlpabf76686_featurestore.fx_rates392bc9_1 f ON t.currency = f.currency
ORDER BY t.event_time LIMIT 5
" 2>&1 | tail -5

cd "$(pwd)" && hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta "
SELECT t.row_id, t.account_id, t.event_time,
  t.amount * f.fx_rate AS amount_usd,
  CASE WHEN (t.event_time/86400000) % 7 IN (2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend,
  SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.event_time RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_7d
FROM delta.mlpabf76686_featurestore.transactions_raw392bc9_1 t
JOIN delta.mlpabf76686_featurestore.fx_rates392bc9_1 f ON t.currency = f.currency
ORDER BY t.event_time LIMIT 5
" 2>&1 | tail -5

cd "$(pwd)" && hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta "
WITH x AS (SELECT account_id, count(*) c FROM delta.mlpabf76686_featurestore.transactions_raw392bc9_1 GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT t.row_id, t.event_time, t.amount,
  SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.event_time RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_7d
FROM delta.mlpabf76686_featurestore.transactions_raw392bc9_1 t
WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM x) ORDER BY t.event_time LIMIT 8
" 2>&1 | tail -3

cd "$(pwd)" && mkdir -p .tmp && hops --no-verify --json sql --catalog delta --limit 0 "
SELECT t.row_id, t.account_id, t.event_time,

  CASE WHEN (t.event_time/86400000) % 7 IN (2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend,

JOIN delta.mlpabf76686_featurestore.fx_rates392bc9_1 f ON t.currency = f.currency
" > .tmp/features_out.json 2>.tmp/sql_err.log; tail -2 .tmp/sql_err.log; echo "=== bytes/rows ==="; wc -c .tmp/features_out.json

cd "$(pwd)" && hops --no-verify --json sql --catalog delta --limit 0 "
SELECT t.row_id || ',' || t.account_id || ',' || CAST(t.event_time AS varchar) || ',' || CAST(t.amount * f.fx_rate AS varchar) || ',' || CAST(CASE WHEN (t.event_time/86400000) % 7 IN (2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS varchar) || ',' || CAST(SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.event_time RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS varchar) AS line
FROM delta.mlpabf76686_featurestore.transactions_raw392bc9_1 t

cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg insert features392bc9 --version 1 --file .tmp/features.csv 2>&1 | tail -6
